gloss: to envy, to be jealous of

definitions.gloss: to envy, to be jealous of
definitions.explanation: To wish you had something that someone else has.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{才能|さいのう}を{羨|うらや}む。
{人|ひと}を{羨|うらや}んでも{仕方|しかた}がない。

notes:
{羨|うらや}む means to envy or feel jealous of what others have.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: Xを{羨|うらや}む (to envy X)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}を{羨|うらや}む: to envy someone
- {才能|さいのう}を{羨|うらや}む: to envy talent
- {成功|せいこう}を{羨|うらや}む: to envy success
- {羨|うらや}んでも{仕方|しかた}がない: it's no use being envious

RELATED FORMS:
- {羨|うらや}ましい: envious, enviable (i-adjective)
- {羨望|せんぼう}: envy, admiration (literary noun)

NUANCE:
{羨|うらや}む and {羨|うらや}ましい express wanting what others have without hostility. For stronger jealousy with resentment, use {嫉妬|しっと}する or {妬|ねた}む.

CONTRAST:
- {羨|うらや}む: to envy (neutral/positive)
- {妬|ねた}む: to be jealous (with resentment)
- {嫉妬|しっと}する: to be jealous (strong emotion)
